capabilities.description: DEVELOPMENT ONLY. The same grants as remote-chroneli, for the local dev server. Deliberately INLINE here rather than a file in capabilities/: a file there is auto-discovered and would ship in every release build, and pinning it out again by listing capabilities in tauri.conf.json is a guarantee that lives in a different file from the risk. Inline, the grant physically cannot exist unless this config is merged, which only `pnpm tauri:dev` does.
